questions.question: Which correction fixes the spelling in: "deloy yolo and run tests"?
options: A. deloy yolo and run tests
B. Deploy YOLO and run tests.
C. deployment yolo and run tests
D. Deploys yolo and run the tests
questions.explanation: The verb is "deploy" (not "deloy"). Capitalize YOLO as a product name and end the command with a period.

questions.question: Which fixes: "I8 has beed deployed in the ~/project/rockchip"?
options: A. I8 has beed deployed in the ~/project/rockchip
B. I8 has been deployed in ~/project/rockchip.
C. I8 have been deployed in the ~/project/rockchip
D. I8 was been deployed in ~/project/rockchip
questions.explanation: Past participle is "been" (not "beed"). Drop "the" before a home-directory path; capitalize I8.

questions.question: Which fixes: "Swich I8 to fp16"?
options: A. Swich I8 to fp16
B. Switch I8 to FP16.
C. Switching I8 to the fp16
D. Switch I8 into fp16 model
questions.explanation: Spell "Switch" correctly. FP16 is a standard precision label and is usually written in uppercase.

questions.question: Which is the most natural way to state the LLM port from the log?
options: A. The LLM service is running on 8080 port
B. The LLM service is running on port 8080.
C. The LLM service runs at the 8080 port number
D. LLM service port is 8080 running
questions.explanation: In English, say "on port 8080" — the port number follows the word "port," not the other way around.

questions.question: Which fixes: "I reboot it, check if the changes for ASR break the LLM service?"
options: A. I reboot it, check if the changes for ASR break the LLM service?
B. I rebooted it; check whether the ASR changes broke the LLM service.
C. I rebooted it, check if the changes for ASR break the LLM?
D. I reboot, checking if ASR changes breaks LLM service
questions.explanation: Use past tense "rebooted" for a completed action. "Whether" fits a yes/no check; a semicolon separates two related instructions.

questions.question: In today's session, what does "test passed" mean when verifying an LLM over HTTP?
options: A. The HTTP request returned any 200 response
B. The server process started without crashing
C. The response content is correct, not just that the request succeeded
D. The port is open and accepting connections
questions.explanation: From the log: "Test passed" means the result is correct, not merely that the request went through.

questions.question: Translate into natural technical English: "8081 是 ASR的"
questions.explanation: Name the port explicitly; "is for ASR" is clearer than a literal "is ASR's" in service documentation.

questions.question: Translate into natural technical English: "3576上小的NPU是做什么的"
questions.modelAnswer: What is the small NPU on the RK3576 used for?
questions.explanation: RK3576 is the board model; "used for" naturally expresses 做什么的 in a hardware context.

questions.question: Translate into natural technical English: "所以从设计上讲, ASR TTS YOLO这些应该放在3576上?"
questions.modelAnswer: So from a design perspective, should ASR, TTS, and YOLO all run on the RK3576?
questions.explanation: "From a design perspective" maps 从设计上讲; list services with commas and name the target board (RK3576).

questions.question: Rewrite as a clear technical instruction: "start the llm-gateway on the board too, and configure the url to the llm on the board"
questions.modelAnswer: Start the llm-gateway on the board as well, and configure its URL to point to the LLM service running on the board.
questions.explanation: Specify what the URL points to (the on-board LLM service) so the gateway routing is unambiguous in a multi-service setup.
